pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark brown polygonal patches on the neck and upper shoulder with smooth to moderately sharp edge gradients; patches significantly decrease in spatial area and shift toward more irregular, rounded geometries on the lower flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light cream pathways forming a continuous topological graph with distinct junction nodes; corridor thickness remains relatively consistent throughout the mid-body, though network density increases significantly toward the lower extremities.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dark, bristly mane visible along the dorsal neck line, producing a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette against the background.
